name: landbot
description: Build, style and publish Landbot bots from your coding agent. Two skills: landbot-flows builds and edits the flow through the Landbot MCP server (live block catalog, AI agent block, publish on your say-so); landbot-style turns a brief into Custom CSS for the v4 web chat and verifies it on the share URL. You sign in to Landbot in your browser; there is no token to copy.
